sloka: तवैतद्वचनं सौम्ये सारवत् स्निग्धमेव च ।रत्नौघाद्विविधाच्चापि देवराज्याद्विशिष्यते ।। ६.११६.२४ ।।
transliteration: tavaitadvacanaṁ saumye sāravat snigdhameva ca ।ratnaughādvividhāccāpi devarājyādviśiṣyate ।। 6.116.24 ।।

translations.english: "Now that the enemy is killed, Rama is happy, which means as if I have attained the rulership of gods."
